meta.title: Starting price below the highest RFQ global charge

plan.title: RFQ conversion rejects low starting price

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on its summary page.
Open the RFQ conversion flow and continue to the auction create screen.
Confirm the conversion landed on the auction creation screen.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, set the starting price to a value below the largest global charge among the RFQ bids, publish the auction, and stop when the screen shows the refusal message "Starting price cannot be less than the maximum global charge of RFQ bids"

steps.note: Perform the starting-price negative case and verify the exact refusal on the buyer screen.
